description: For skills the user already installed (up to 100 of {source: owner/repo, path: folder, commit?}, as skills-lock.json lists them): which were confirmed dangerous by an aiqbench administrator, and for each skill aiqbench knows, whether its last checked commit differs from the installed one (a newer checked version may exist; never a finding about the installed one). Nothing is stored or logged.
name: check_installed
title: Check installed skills
